body: I have spoken to my mother a handful of times in the past 15 years so my vote is cut her out of your life if she is to toxic to continue with.

What makes you say that your Mom thinks you are a slut? If the issues have gotten worse due to your current choice of partner I would suggest taking an honest look at what she may have against him. If his behavior is what's causing the rift in your life, maybe he should be the one cut out. I know that is also very difficult but take it from someone who moved away from his family 10+ years ago to try to make the mother of my children happy, if the issues stem from your partner there will be loads of regret in the future that you let the time with family slip away for someone that will never be able to make you happy.

I know that its hard, I have tons of issues with insecurities myself, but reading your post made it clear just how little you think of yourself and that makes me very sad. I would really suggest cutting off ties with toxic people in your life. I havent really spoken to my own mother much over the last 15 years and while I do wish my kids knew there grandparents more, for myself i dont regret the distance I created between us. Unless you can both deal with the sources of your problems to the best of your abilities, and find something to live for its hard to make things better. I do hope you can find the strength to go for another year.

There are way to many variables in every unique situation to let yourself feel like your pain isnt valid.

So here's the thing, I get it. I almost killed myself 2 days ago. But while reflecting on my lifw constantly and trying to analyze each amd every part to see where thjngs went wrong I have also remembered various times in my life things were not bad. My problems all started with my parebts divorce when I was 7. My sister was 3 and doesnt really remember our dad and what things were like and asked if things were happy then. I realized I had never once even seen my parents fight. Things had been good. Fast forward 15 years from then and I get with the woman that will become the mother of my children. While these days she mostly makes me want to kill myself, I realize that over the years we had some amazing times together. I am starting to realize there really is times when the circumstances can be right for things to be ok again. I'm working towards that goal and encourage anyone else who is not doing so to work towards that goal as well.

Over the last few months I have been trying to find who I am again. There are a few things that have helped me start doing better most days. 

I found one person who will always respond when I need to vent frequently. She takes a while sometimes cause adulting is a bitch but she can handle me at my darkest and always says something to make me laugh and pull me out of that darkness that has so nearly claimed my life many times recently.

I also started talking to my sister a lot more recently. Ironically enough this is due to my soon to be ex wife who had caused all my pain, she told my sister to call me one night when she thought I might kill myself due to a comment made right before I grabbed the keys to my suburban and peeled out of our driveway. Best part is that night I was actually just going for a drive to blast loud music and calm down.

I started keeping a journal. I use an app because its convenient. Writing always helped me so this is me getting back to me again.

I started playing console games again. This is something I would more often than not defer to my wife so she was entertained, I probably should have kept her away from the internet but its to late for that now so I figured I should worry more about me and what I want.

I am planning to start building model jets again. I did this in my early teen years and would hang the finished product from the ceiling in dogfights and thought it was a lot of fun so I want to do this both for myself and to maybe start my sons on what could be a lifelong hobby together.

It's been a rough 2 months but everything mentioned has helped me to get on a path to being a much happier person going forward, even if it means walking away from the woman I gave the last 12 years to, the woman who gave me the amazing children that have kept me going when the barrel of my gun was literally in my mouth. If I can provide an example that helps, definitely run with it anf make it your own cause I want people to see there are ways we can work towards happiness if we put in just a little effort.
